explainer_content.short_definition: Seattle alternative at the 1990s center: punk damage, metal weight, and hooks big enough for everyone.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Grunge carried underground values into mainstream rock through Seattle bands whose songs felt raw, heavy, melodic, and emotionally direct.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It reset rock radio and youth culture in the early 1990s.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The center is the collision: punk dynamics, heavy guitar, flannel-era anti-glam stance, and memorable choruses.
